subject: angol
title: Taxing unhealthy food
instructionsHu: Vitatkozz a vizsgáztatóval az alábbi állításról. A kiosztott álláspontod: az állítás MELLETT érvelsz – ezt az álláspontot a vita során nem változtathatod meg. Fejtsd ki az érveidet, reagálj a vizsgáztató ellenérveire, és próbáld meggyőzni őt.

debate.statement: Unhealthy food and sugary drinks should be taxed much more heavily
candidateIdeas: Higher prices make people buy less unhealthy food, especially children and teenagers.
Obesity and diabetes cost the health care system a huge amount of money.
The money from the tax could make fruit, vegetables and sports facilities cheaper.
Food companies would be encouraged to reduce the sugar and salt in their products.
Similar taxes on cigarettes have helped to reduce smoking.
examinerArguments: Such taxes hit poorer families hardest because they spend a larger part of their income on food.
Adults should be free to decide what they eat without the state interfering.
People will buy unhealthy products anyway, or buy them in another country.
Education about nutrition works better than punishment.
It is difficult to define what 'unhealthy food' actually is.

followUpQuestions: Isn't it unfair that poorer families will suffer most from higher prices?
Why should the state decide what adults eat?
Wouldn't it be better to teach people about healthy eating instead?

usefulPhrases.en: The revenue could be spent on ...

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Let's discuss this statement: 'Unhealthy food and sugary drinks should be taxed much more heavily.' What do you think?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: I strongly believe it's a good idea. First of all, price really does influence what people buy, especially children and teenagers, who don't have much money. If a can of cola cost twice as much, many of my classmates would simply drink water instead. Secondly, obesity and diabetes cost the health care system a fortune, so it's only fair that the products causing them help to pay for the treatment.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: But such taxes hit poorer families hardest, because they spend a larger part of their income on food.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: That's a fair point, and the tax mustn't become a burden on the poor. That's why the money should be used to make fruit, vegetables and sports facilities cheaper. That way, low-income families would actually benefit if they changed their habits.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Still, adults should be free to decide what they eat without the state interfering.

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: But nobody would be forbidden to eat anything – crisps would still be in the shops. It's the same with cigarettes: they're heavily taxed but not banned, and far fewer people smoke than twenty years ago. Food companies would also be encouraged to reduce the sugar and salt in their products.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: Wouldn't it be better to teach people about healthy eating instead?

turns.speaker: candidate
turns.text: Education is essential, I'm not denying that. But knowledge alone rarely changes behaviour – most people know perfectly well that sugary drinks are bad for them. So I'd say we need both: nutrition lessons at school and a tax that gives people an extra reason to choose the healthier option.

turns.speaker: examiner
turns.text: So you'd combine the two. That sounds like a reasonable compromise.

notes: Feladat teljesítése: a vizsgázó végig megtartja a kiosztott (az állítás melletti) álláspontot, a nyitó részben két erős érvet fejt ki példával, majd mindhárom ellenérvre reagál: részben egyetért, cáfol (a cigaretta példája), végül kompromisszumot javasol (oktatás és adó együtt).

Szókincs: gazdag érvelő nyelv (First of all, Secondly, That's a fair point, I'm not denying that, So I'd say we need both) és a téma pontos szavai (obesity, a burden on the poor, low-income families).

Nyelvhelyesség: változatos B2-es szerkezetek hibátlanul – második feltételes mondat (If a can of cola cost twice as much, … would), nyomatékosító 'does', 'mustn't', szenvedő szerkezet (would be forbidden, are heavily taxed) és a 'That way, …' következtetés.
Érdemes megtanulni: „cost the health care system a fortune”, „That's a fair point”, „I'm not denying that”, „gives people an extra reason to”.
